text:
Assistant A provides a technically accurate and well-structured response. It correctly identifies the components of a solar thermal system (collectors, heat exchangers, etc.) and provides a logical workflow and a set of design considerations.

Assistant B is very poor. It confuses solar thermal heating (heating water directly with the sun) with solar photovoltaics (generating electricity to heat water), and then proceeds to list the same components twice in a repetitive loop (a through p). Furthermore, its five-step workflow is overly generic and lacks any actual design detail.

[[A]]
